context: History documentary discussion: Asuka and Ren on the postwar world.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: history discussion; geopolitics vocabulary (県/ドイツ/米国/軍/平成) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 戦後、ドイツはどう復興したんですか?
lines.en: How did Germany rebuild after the war?
lines.style: curious young man voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 米国等の支援を受けて、立て直しました。
lines.en: It rebuilt with support from the US and others.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 米国の軍も、駐留したんですか?
lines.en: Did the US military station there too?
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、各地に軍が置かれました。
lines.en: Yes, forces were placed in various regions.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 日本は、平成に何が変わりましたか?
lines.en: What changed for Japan in Heisei?
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 平成は、国際協力が広がった時代です。
lines.en: Heisei was an age when international cooperation spread.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ドイツ等の例から、学べそうですね。
lines.en: We can learn from examples like Germany.
lines.style: understanding young man voice, soft warm reflective throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史は、平成も含めて続いていますよ。
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout
